title: Meta Faces Backlash After Watchdog Uncovers Hundreds of Ads Featuring AI-Generated Child Abuse Imagery
snippet: A human rights watchdog claims Meta permitted more than 300 advertisements featuring suspected AI-generated child sexual abuse material across its social media platforms.
content:
Tech giant Meta is facing renewed scrutiny after a non-governmental organization revealed that the company approved and ran more than 300 advertisements containing suspected AI-generated child sexual abuse material across its networks.

Flaws in Automated Moderation

According to the report released by the digital watchdog, the problematic ads leveraged sophisticated generative artificial intelligence tools to bypass standard content filters. The advertisements were actively served to users on major platforms, including Facebook and Instagram, before being flagged by external researchers.

Growing Pressure on Big Tech

The findings highlight the escalating threat posed by synthetic media and raise serious questions about the effectiveness of Meta's automated ad review systems. Digital safety advocates and lawmakers are now calling for immediate transparency and stricter enforcement protocols to prevent generative AI from being weaponized on mainstream public platforms.
